The '''EVS BBS-909''' was an emergency vacuum seal manufactured by [[Galvronos Givin Interchanges, Limited]]. Portable and fast-acting, the EVS BBS-909 was a circular disk that used [[micro-molecular grip-lock]]s to lock into place. A mild electrical current then stimulated [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] micro-organisms that usually lived in vacuum that multiplied and created a biological seal.
